identification: Two-tier rusted cast iron garden fountain, scalloped basins, acanthus baluster, octagonal plinth, likely modern/reproduction, no mark seen, no pump
viewing_check: Look for foundry marks or casting numbers on base and basins, check basin cracks and whether base plinth is cast iron, count sections and whether it separates for transport (heavy).
searches_tried: eBay AU sold 'cast iron two tier garden fountain' (AU only), eBay AU sold 'cast iron tiered fountain garden' (all junk: bird baths, doorstops). No usable comps.

identification: Nissan Generator NDG5B Brushless diesel set, electric start, tubular frame, heavy rust on tank/frame (photo confirms badge).
viewing_check: Check whether engine turns over, battery state, oil/fuel condition, outlet panel and alternator output if a test is allowed; tank rust.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: nissan diesel generator NDG; nissan generator brushless diesel NDG5B (only Nissan car alternators/junk, no generator comps)

identification: Unbranded green painted floor-standing vertical band saw, enclosed steel base, tilting table, roughly 14 inch; no maker visible.
viewing_check: Look for maker plate (wheel cover, base, motor), motor voltage/phase (single vs 3 phase), wheel size, blade guide condition, and whether it runs.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: cast iron band saw vertical floor; vintage bandsaw 14 inch floor; bandsaw 240v pickup (all junk: blades, trunnions, parts). No whole-machine sold comps. Gumtree not searched (no sold data).

identification: Large vintage industrial hardwood workshop/shop counter cabinet, about 2.1m, mix of open bays and drawers with label holders and metal pulls, about 8 of 12 drawers present, heavily weathered.
viewing_check: Check drawer count and runners, top condition, rot/borer, whether it dismantles for transport, and timber species (underside or back). Weight and removal are the main costs.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold (Australia only): industrial workshop drawers cabinet timber vintage counter; vintage shop counter multi drawer hardwood industrial. Only junk matches (small cabinets, metal parts cabinets), nothing recorded.

identification: Strapped pallet of new Tasmanian oak tongue and groove lining boards, approx 14 sqm, mixed lengths, some short, pallet marked batch R122
viewing_check: Measure board width and thickness, read the profile and grade stamp, check lengths (how many full length vs offcuts), moisture or stain, and count boards to confirm area.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold 'tasmanian oak tongue groove lining' (AU only): all junk (furniture, router bits). Gumtree not searched (not reliably sold prices). No usable comps.

identification: Leitner step-over electric bike, black, rear-rack battery, disc brakes, helmet and rack bag (photo).
viewing_check: Check battery holds charge/age, charger included and matching, motor runs, brakes, tyres, key present.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: leitner electric bike (60 results, none Leitner bikes); leitner ebike bicycle AU only (one Leitner Venice Cruiser charger+toolkit sold A$21.90 6 Sep 2026, not a bike so not recorded)

identification: Goulds Mfg Co (Seneca Falls) flywheel-driven pump on cast base, red paint with gold lining, repainted, about 92 cm; lettering 'The Goulds Mfg Co' visible.
viewing_check: Check the model/number cast on the body (No 3 Royal?), that the flywheel turns and the plunger is not seized, any cracks in the casting, and whether the paint hides repairs.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: goulds pump flywheel (modern Goulds pumps and manuals, junk); antique goulds hand pump cast iron (error page); antique cast iron pump flywheel (UK village pumps A$1,350-1,730 and modern reproductions, not same). No same-item sold comps found.

identification: Goldstein Rapid Fry twin-pan electric deep fryer bank (2 pans x 2 baskets) on castors, catalogue IRF24D, likely FRE24D family; plate not legible.
viewing_check: Photograph the compliance plate (model, voltage, phase, kW): 3-phase will limit buyers. Check elements, thermostats, pan condition and castors, and that it is electric not gas. Removal needs a trolley and two people.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: goldstein fryer (error page, none); commercial electric deep fryer twin basket (error); commercial electric deep fryer (only small countertop 10L units at A$60-250, not comparable, not recorded); goldstein commercial kitchen (junk). Gumtree not tried.

identification: Cream-painted cast and wrought iron child's cot with brass ball finials, knuckle joints, slatted iron base; Victorian style, about 90 H x 118 W cm, unmarked
viewing_check: Check for maker plate or registration marks, that finials are solid brass, any breaks or repairs to joints, whether the base slats and drop side fit, and layers of old paint.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold 'antique victorian iron cot brass finials', 'antique iron cot brass', 'victorian cast iron brass baby cot' (AU only): no results for any. No usable comps.

identification: Five large blue VOLVO dealership letters about 53 cm high, one letter's frame/backing visible (photo; V-O-L-V-O).

searches_tried: eBay AU sold: volvo sign letters dealership (only small OEM car badges A$6-36 and a desktop sign A$63, not comparable, not recorded)

identification: Approx 180 lineal metres of Tasmanian oak architrave (90 lm 65mm, 90 lm 85mm), strapped packs, appears unused, mixed lengths.

searches_tried: eBay AU sold: tasmanian oak architrave and tasmanian oak timber lengths (both returned eBay error page, no results). Bulk timber is rarely sold on eBay; nothing recorded.
